# RawIntent Consumer Request - Official full-runtime AutoSci integration test through normal solar intake. Do not call a

## Rewritten Objective

Official full-runtime AutoSci integration test through normal solar intake. Do not call a 

## Problem

Official full-runtime AutoSci integration test through normal solar intake. Do not call a manual autosci shim. The workflow must ingest papers, extract claims, generate ideas, run exp-design, exp-run, exp-eval, and produce a report.

## Constraints

- All execution must enter Solar-Harness through RawIntent and requirement compilation.
- Do not bypass task_graph, operator runtime, quota-aware fallback, or evidence logging.

## Acceptance

- RawIntent, rewritten_intent, requirement_ir, and requirement_trace artifacts are persisted.
- Compiled work is routable through PM/Planner/task_graph and multi-task operator runtime.
- Completion requires evidence artifacts and verifier-visible status.

## Raw User Intent

Official full-runtime AutoSci integration test through normal solar intake. Do not call a manual autosci shim. The workflow must ingest papers, extract claims, generate ideas, run exp-design, exp-run, exp-eval, and produce a report.
